title: Apocrustic
summary: APOCRUST'IC, adjective [Gr. from, to drive from.] Astringent; repelling. APOCRUST'IC, noun A medicine which constringes, and repels the humors; a repellent.

inlines.v: APOCRUST'IC, adjective [Gr. from, to drive from.] Astringent; repelling. APOCRUST'IC, noun A medicine which constringes, and repels the humors; a repellent.
